nodes.name: HESTIA Data Platform
nodes.geography: 100+ countries stated on the current official page
nodes.sector: Crops, livestock, aquaculture and processed food

nodes.name: GreenGrocer project
nodes.geography: 11 European countries with global food-supply-chain scope
nodes.sector: Food production, trade, diets, marine foods, cold chains and novel foods

relationships.evidence: HESTIA stores and distributes platform entities using its linked data standard.
relationships.constraints: Release and schema evolution need version pairing.

relationships.evidence: Platform releases recalculate public data with the current HESTIA model set.
relationships.constraints: Newer model sets can change impact results.

relationships.evidence: openLCA 2.6+ includes an experimental HESTIA client for importing Cycles through the API.
relationships.constraints: Account/token is needed in the client and compatibility is release-specific.
relationships.validation_question: Track openLCA and HESTIA release pairings.

relationships.evidence: GreenGrocer states that it will strengthen HESTIA and deploy its farm sustainability toolkit to about 20,000 farms.
relationships.constraints: Future GreenGrocer outputs may not share HESTIA release/licence terms.

relationships.evidence: University of Oxford / HESTIA project is publicly identified as owner for HESTIA Data Platform.
relationships.constraints: The public actor label is preserved as published; entity typing is Not typed in this review.
relationships.validation_question: Recheck the actor identity and role against the public source in the next evidence review.
